notes.content:
Chapter 2 (Daily) has been updated, but the version has reverted due to deletion of save data or a bug.
About this serious specification, the author does not understand,
We apologize for any inconvenience caused to our players.

Regarding future updates on Steam, we will stop frequent updates and

Perhaps what is currently being released on Steam is called a trial version,
The next Steam update may come after completion.
In that case, we will publish it externally, such as the public DL version for each chapter.

To all players who are playing Steam Early Access
Thank you very much. We also apologize for causing such an issue.

In the unlikely event that there is a bug, please consider other play methods such as the DL version and contact the author.
Romankessha@gmail.com

notes.title: About updates after Chapter 2
notes.content:
There was a freeze bug in the part that worked correctly in the introduction and chapter 1. 
Therefore, it will be dealt with below.

◼️ DL version
It will be delivered chapter by chapter from Chapter 2.
From the official GiseiHero site, open the site that distributes the DL version.
◼️ Steam version
We will update the introductory chapter and chapter1 as they are fixed so that all chapters can be integrated and distributed.
→ It takes time, so if you want to play faster, please consider the DL version.
◼️ gallery mode
Since it is important to take over the save data, it may not be implemented from the next update data to the full version.
(Planned to be implemented in full version)

There is no connection between chapters until the full version, so there is no need to take over the save data.
I think that you can enjoy the main story without any problem even with the above method. 

* It's been a long time since the introduction and production of Chapter 1, so I think that the parts installed in the past did not work properly due to the update of the production tool and the specification change.
* Contents are subject to change.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38741736/eb5f9cfd7658c89ca7f7dc13d056b2a5cb63c590.jpg[/img]
